summary: Verified Emergent File & Media Storage integration end-to-end after EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was set in backend/.env. All 5 acceptance criteria pass: (1) /library/storage returns enabled=true provider='Emergent File & Media Storage' message='Storage connected'; (2) UI shows storage-connection-badge='Connected', storage-message='Storage connected', and all upload buttons (upload-file-button, browse-document-button, browse-image-button) ENABLED; (3) UI file upload via set_input_files on data-testid=library-file-input successfully created a library-item card with correct filename and increased used_bytes on storage card; (4) preview panel opens on preview-item-<id> click, and /api/library/items/<id>/download returns HTTP 200 with exact file contents; (5) delete-item-<id> (with window.confirm accepted) removes item; note creation (create-note-button → note-name-input + note-content-input → save-note-button) works; teacher login + upload works and item is marked retrieval_status='ready_for_future_retrieval'. No CORS/403 errors observed.

verification_results.GET /api/library/storage: 200 {enabled:true, provider:'Emergent File & Media Storage', limit_bytes:524288000, used_bytes:0, message:'Storage connected'}
verification_results.POST /api/library/upload (student, .txt): 200 created LibraryItem, storage_path='learnlens/uploads/demo-student/<uuid>.txt', source_metadata.source='Personal student library', retrieval_status='not_applicable'
verification_results.DELETE /api/library/items/<id>: 204 (307 redirect issue only when trailing slash used); item removed from GET /items
verification_results.UI upload flow: set_input_files triggers uploadMany → library-item-<uuid> card appears with filename
verification_results.UI preview panel: opens on preview-item click; close-preview-button works
verification_results.UI delete flow: window.confirm accepted → deleteItem mutation → item removed from grid
verification_results.UI note flow: note created and rendered as library item card

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The `download_item` handler in routers/library.py sends Content-Disposition 'inline' rather than 'attachment' for file kind — this matches the frontend preview/download flow (window.open in a new tab renders inline), so this is intentional but worth noting for API clients that expect a forced download.

Minor: Upload button is disabled immediately on page load because storage.data is undefined until the /library/storage query resolves; users may see 'Disabled' badge briefly (~200-800ms) before it flips to 'Connected'. Consider showing a 'Checking storage…' skeleton/loader instead of the amber 'Disabled' badge during the initial fetch.
Info: DELETE endpoint at /api/library/items/<id> issues a 307 redirect when called with trailing slash; the frontend does not use a trailing slash so no user impact.
seed_data_creation: All test artifacts (student .txt upload, teacher .txt upload, TEST_ note, TEST_UI_note) were deleted at end of tests. Final library state: 0 items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set in /app/backend/.env enabling Emergent File & Media Storage via services/storage.py. Storage endpoints under /api/library/* all healthy. Frontend Vite proxy sends /api → localhost:8001; public preview at https://lens-inspect-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Note the storage badge may briefly show 'Disabled/Checking storage…' before the query resolves — wait ~1s (or wait_for_function on badge text) before asserting.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification only. Feature was previously gated OFF via missing EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; adding it in backend/.env enables storage_enabled() to return True and all upload/download flows now work end-to-end.
